answer: The smith quenches every blade and stamps it with his mark while the steel is still warm, because a cold stamp can be faked. Bailiff certification with enforcement authority attestation is that hot stamp: one-year training, 200 supervised enforcements, exam, annual renewal. The marble is one blade, forged from bar iron and ground on the wheel. A blade stamped with a stolen mark is broken at the guild court, and the raven is the damages, a year's earnings paid to the man whose mark was taken. The delta is the guild book of marks, kept in the hall and shown to every buyer.
